The '''Coruscant Criminal Records Office''' was an office of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that maintained records of criminals. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] once issued a request to the office for any information on several names.
